P.name: Dauntless Instinct
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''K'Sante's''' {{tip|abilities}} mark enemies hit for 4 seconds. His {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} against marked enemies are empowered to consume the mark, dealing {{as|12|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{pplevel|1 to 2|key=%}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio deals a minimum of {{pplevel|10 + 5*x}} against {{tip|minion|minions}} and is capped at {{pplevel|15 + 5*x}} against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
P.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|All Out|K'Sante|All Out}} Bonus:}} '''K'Sante's''' basic attacks and {{tip|ability damage}}, as well as ''Dauntless Instinct's'' mark consumption, are empowered to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|1% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 1% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.

Q.name: Ntofo Strikes
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''K'Sante''' slams his ntofo down in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
Q.description2: If this hits at least one enemy, '''K'Sante''' generates a {{tip|stack}} for 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 times and refreshing on subsequent hits. At 2 stacks, the next ''Ntofo Strikes'' cast consumes them all to become empowered with a new effect.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Empowered Active:}} '''K'Sante''' fires a shockwave in the target direction that applies the same effects to enemies hit, but also {{tip|airborne|pulls}} them towards him over {{fd|0.65}} seconds and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.8}} seconds.
Q.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|All Out|K'Sante|All Out}} Bonus:}} ''Ntofo Strikes' '' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 33%<!--, with a minimum total cooldown of {{fd|1.33}} seconds (hard coded, make visible if the % reduction would otherwise put it below 1.33)-->. Upon entering ''All Out'', ''Ntofo Strikes' '' stacks are reset. ''Ntofo Strikes' '' {{sti|cooldown}} is reset if '''K'Sante''' had 2 stacks before entering ''All Out''.
Q.description5: ''Ntofo Strikes {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''K'Sante's''' basic attack timer.''
Q.cast time: {{pp|0.45 to 0.35 by 0.01|0 to 120|type='''bonus''' resistances|label=cast time|label1=bonus resistances|formula= 0.45 - (1/1200) × bonus resistances, capped at 120 bonus resistances.}}
Q.static: {{dv|{{pp|3.5 to 2 by 0.05|0 to 120|type='''bonus''' resistances|label=cooldown|label1=bonus resistances|formula= 3.5 - 0.0125 × bonus resistances, capped at 120 bonus resistances.}}|{{pp|3.5*2/3 to 2*2/3 by 0.3/9|0 to 120|type='''bonus''' resistances|label=cooldown|label1=bonus resistances|formula= During All Out. 3.5 * 2 / 3 - (0.0125 * 2 / 3) × bonus resistances, capped at 120 bonus resistances.|showtype=false}}}}

W.name: Path Maker
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''K'Sante''' raises his ntofos defensively and prepares to {{tip|dash}} in the target direction, {{tip|channel|charging}} for a minimum of {{fd|0.4}} seconds and up to 1 second. During this time, he gains {{tip|displacement immunity}} and 30% damage reduction; additionally, ''Path Maker's'' range, {{tip|stun}} duration, and ''{{ai|All Out|K'Sante}}'' {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} modifier increase over the first {{fd|0.9}} seconds of the channel.
W.description2: ''Path Maker'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. ''Path Maker's'' charge cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|crowd control}}.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''K'Sante''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the direction he targeted at the time of cast, though not through terrain, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through, {{tip|airborne|carrying}} them alongside him, and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{pp|type=channel time|label1=Channel duration|0.5 to 1.75 for 11|0.4 to 0.9|formula=0.5 + 0.125 for every 0.05 seconds channeling, capped at 0.9 seconds.}} seconds. This damage is capped against {{tip|monsters}}.
W.leveling3: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|45 to 165}} {{as|(+ 8%|hp}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}{{st|Monster Damage Cap|{{ap|180 to 500}}}}
W.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|All Out|K'Sante|All Out}} Bonus:}} ''Path Maker'' no longer applies its {{tip|airborne|knock back}} and {{tip|stun}}, but its damage reduction is increased to 75%, the dash deals {{sti|true damage|{{as|{{pp|key=%|type=channel time|label1=Channel duration|10 to 80|0.4 to 0.9 by 0.05|formula=10% + 7% for every 0.05 seconds channeling, capped at 0.9 seconds.}} '''bonus''' true damage}}}}, and the dash speed is increased by 20%. Upon entering ''All Out'', ''Path Maker's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is refreshed.
W.leveling4: {{st|Minimum Bonus True Damage|{{ap|45*0.1 to 165*0.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8*0.1}}%|hp}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*0.1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*0.1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Maximum Bonus True Damage|{{ap|45*0.8 to 165*0.8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8*0.8}}%|hp}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*0.8}}% per 100 '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*0.8}}% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Total Maximum Mixed Damage|{{ap|45*1.8 to 165*1.8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8*1.8}}%|hp}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*1.8}}% per 100 '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*1.8}}% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
W.description5: ''{{ai|Ntofo Strikes|K'Sante}} and {{ai|All Out|K'Sante}} can be cast during the dash. Path Maker's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

E.name: Footwork
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''K'Sante''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location, though not through terrain, and grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds.
E.description2: ''Footwork'' can also be cast on allies with increased range and speed, and the ability to {{tip|dash}} through terrain. If the target ally is a {{tip|champion}}, they receive the {{tip|shield}} as well.
E.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|All Out|K'Sante|All Out}} Bonus:}} ''Footwork's'' dash speed is increased, and its cooldown is reduced by 50%.
E.description4: '''''K'Sante''' can cast any of his {{tip|abilities}} during the dash.''

R.name: All Out
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''K'Sante''' {{tip|root|roots}} the target enemy {{tip|champion}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds|Duration unaffected by tenacity}} and gains {{tip|displacement immunity}} over the cast time. He then shatters his ntofos, {{tip|airborne|pulling}} the target to a location that is 300 units in the cast direction from their location at the time of cast, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}, and {{tip|blink|blinking}} {{tt|175 units|Beyond the target's hitbox's edge}} behind that location. The target is dealt {{as|physical damage}} near the end of the displacement and is {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.3}} seconds once it ends.
R.description2: If there is {{tt|valid map-generated terrain|Terrain that has an opposite side (non-border) and is not player-generated.}} 350 units in the cast direction from the target's location at the time of cast, the target is instead {{tip|airborne|pulled}} to a location that is directly 450 units away from the edge of the other side of the terrain and '''K'Sante''' {{tip|blink|blinks}} 100 units behind that location, dealing them the {{as|physical damage}} near their emergence from the terrain. At the end of the displacement, they remain {{tip|airborne}} for {{rutngt|0.25}}, after which they are {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. '''K'Sante''' strikes them after {{rutngt|0.125}} into the airborne duration to deal {{as|physical damage}}.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Strike Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 150}} {{as|(+ 5% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|80*2 to 150*2}} {{as|(+ 5% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
R.description3: After '''K'Sante''' {{tip|blink|blinks}}, he enters ''All Out'' for 15 seconds.
R.description4:
{{sbc|All Out:}} '''K'Sante''' gains a [[Health#Health_threshold|health threshold]] equal to {{sti|{{as|65% '''maximum''' health}}}} which cannot be {{tt|modified|By increases or decreases to maximum health}} nor {{tt|exceeded|By healing and health regeneration}} by any means. Upon entering ''All Out'', his {{as|'''current''' health}} is reduced to this threshold if it is above it. Additionally, his {{sti|armor|{{as|'''base''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''base''' magic resistance}}}} are reduced by {{as|85% '''bonus''' armor}} and {{as|85% '''bonus''' magic resistance}}, respectively. In return, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, {{sti|lethality|{{as|50% {{tt|'''bonus'''-armor penetration|Affects bonus armor only}}}}}}, and {{sti|{{as|20% omnivamp}}}}, and modifies his {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} which can be cast at no cost.

Upon entering ''All Out'', '''K'Sante''' is restored to {{as|100% '''maximum''' mana}}. His {{as|mana}} then decays to {{as|0|mana}} over the duration of the buff, after which the {{tt|amount of {{as|mana}}|Preserves the exact amount of mana, not his mana percentage at the time}} he had {{tt|prior to entering ''All Out''|After paying All Out's mana cost}} is restored.
R.description5: '''''K'Sante''' retains his {{as|'''maximum''' health}} and '''bonus''' resistances during All Out. Health lost from gaining the health threshold is '''not''' restored after the effect ends. If the target is pulled over terrain, '''K'Sante''' will {{tip|vanish}} during their displacement and reappear near the end of it.''
